comparison.scope: Equivalent complete 27-client workload, local sequential runs, same observer and parameters; a single paired observation is not a universal speed guarantee.

interpretation.integrity: All three full classroom runs passed the integrity and authorization assertions.
interpretation.latency: All-client bursts exceed the investigative 150 ms ACK p95 budget. The 25-minute 20x run also exceeds event-loop p99 by 3.35 ms. These exceptions remain open.
interpretation.memory: RSS includes native and worker memory; worker heap is not worker RSS. Slopes describe sampled observations, not proof of a leak or its absence.
interpretation.cadence: Per-process tick counts may omit the explicitly documented final SIGKILL sampling tail; final persisted game time is checked separately.
interpretation.storage: Per-generation payloads are logical bytes; physical SQLite pages/indices are shared and reported globally.
